title: KAITO — The Troupe Leader's Day Off〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm so excited♪ I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO, when's everybody gonna get here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm sure they'll be here soon.
Ah, there we are...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcooome♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay, it's KAITO and Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... Is Rin not with you today?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, she's busy practicing for a show with the plushies today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So we're the only ones free to help you right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And you'll do just fine.
We really appreciate it, KAITO, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course. You're here to discuss some things about your new show, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! As we mentioned before, Wonderlands×Showtime has been given the honor of being ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And for our first assignment, we'll be performing on a stage by the beach owned by an affiliate hotel!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The beach? That sounds fantastic. A show by the sea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! That's gonna be so much fun with the water being so wavy and sparkly♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Just like the Seaside School...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, do you already know what sort of show you'd like to do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be paying homage to the Little Mermaid this time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've been asked to put on a family-oriented show, so we'd like to take the original tragedy and turn it into something more fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've come up with some ideas pertaining to the details, but we still don't know what to do about the overall story. Mind helping us out with that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It would be our pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ You can count on us♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Then let's get right to it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The original Little Mermaid involves sisters as well, so you may be able to dive deeper into those relationships...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There's the human prince too.
Instead of falling in love, it may be better to have them simply become friends...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, me next! What if we do a story that everyone can have fun with and goes all zing-zang-zoom♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Zing-zang-zoom?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Emu, so you wish to make it more of an adventure?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How the...?!
What is it with you and Rui?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That may be because of my proximity to Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sort of comes to me naturally as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I only understood the first part of what she said...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shall I add that to my Emu-to-English dictionary, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? You have an Emu-to-English dictionary? Since when?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I installed it just the other day while I was performing some maintenance on her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Great, another weird function she doesn't really need...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So what do you think?!
A story that goes zing-zang-zoom!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I think it's a good idea.
By making it an adventure, you'll be free to add in other ideas and make the story more fun overall.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The original Little Mermaid also seemed to be quite familiar with human culture, so she'd fit right into an adventure of that sort, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. Our adventure shows in particular have also been doing the best as far as we've seen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, they're our strong suit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, as part of making sure that our first assignment as ambassadors succeeds, it may be wise to choose something we're most familiar with to start.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It'll also be a good way to sort of show everyone what we're like, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, adventure it is.
Shall we start working on the finer points of the story?

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! Let's take a look at some of the ideas we've already come up with!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, this is a nice twist.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since you're paying homage to the Little Mermaid, this may be just what you need. For example...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would make for quite the twist! I'll be sure to consider it, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, if I were the Little Mermaid, I might flap around on the beach like a fish the first time I come ashore!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's a mermaid! Not a fish!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our ideas are coming along rather nicely!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they are. Although, I'd like to add in some scenes that bear close resemblance to the original story.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Nene, didn't you see a theatrical rendition of the Little Mermaid a long time ago?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's right!
Which scenes stuck out to you the most?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean like when she meets the prince or asks the sea witch for legs?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, yes. That scene with her and the sea witch may do nicely.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, is that when she drinks the potion that the sea witch gives her and turns into a human?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, she drinks the potion and grows human legs.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if the sea witch gives her the wrong potion and turns the Little Mermaid's legs into a bunch of wriggly octopus legs?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. The witch could even say, Oops, and after that, give the Little Mermaid a potion that gives her legs but they end up being half-fish or something.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That would be hilarious.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excellent!
These are some great ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should have more than enough to spice up our script, so why don't we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure. I'll take what we've come up with and start working in some effects too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for your help, Miku, KAITO. We promise to make this show a good one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Bye, Miku! Bye, KAITO!
See you later♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye bye☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You had a lot of fun, didn't you, KAITO? You had this great big smiley face the whole time☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm just incredibly excited about seeing how their story turns out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I hope I get a chance to see it too since it's going to be such a big moment for them. Their ambassadorial debut.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
Shall we get back to the stage?
